finding.statement: The evaluator can report ELIGIBLE_FOR_FINAL_REVIEW and local_hardware_receipt_bound=true from caller-asserted strings/booleans without verifying that upstream workpackages are actually accepted at their required exact scopes or that the local hardware evidence reference denotes a real verified receipt.
finding.non_inflation_note: The reviewed source hard-codes terminal_acceptance_minted=false and whole_system_acceptance=false, so this review does NOT claim that terminal acceptance can currently be minted. The defect is narrower: the eligibility signal and local_hardware_receipt_bound field can be satisfied by unverified assertions.

why_the_witness_is_constructible: UpstreamAcceptance validates workpackage_id/accepted_scope/receipt_ref as trimmed strings and receipt_sha256 only as lowercase 64-hex; it does not validate receipt contents, acceptance state, exact accepted scope, repository identity, or receipt digest against fetched bytes.
Dependency closure is computed from presence of the five required workpackage IDs only.
PerceptionAcceptanceCase accepts any non-empty evidence_ref and a caller-supplied synthetic boolean.
local_hardware_receipt_bound becomes true solely when the local case says PASS and synthetic=false; no typed local-device receipt or verifier result is required.
counterhypothesis: This may be an intentional separation of pure evidence-shape evaluation from a later trusted receipt-verification layer. If so, the current names local_hardware_receipt_bound and ELIGIBLE_FOR_FINAL_REVIEW overstate what this pure layer has established unless the caller boundary is explicitly typed/trusted and enforced elsewhere.
cheapest_discriminator: On the WP714 implementation branch, add a regression that constructs the witness above. If the current function returns ELIGIBLE_FOR_FINAL_REVIEW with local_hardware_receipt_bound=true, either make that test fail under a stricter verified-receipt contract or rename/re-scope the assessment so unverified evidence cannot be mistaken for bound acceptance evidence.
suggested_repair_options: Require typed verified upstream receipt objects whose workpackage_id, acceptance state, accepted_scope, source identity and digest have already been deterministically checked against canonical receipt bytes.
Require the local real-device case to bind a typed local-device/OS-permission receipt with exact source/provenance/digest verification rather than deriving receipt_bound from synthetic=false.

If verification intentionally lives outside this module, rename the booleans/assessment to asserted_evidence_present or structurally_eligible and make the trusted verification boundary explicit in schema/tests.
next_exact_action: WP714 owner should run the static witness as a regression on its isolated branch and either harden receipt verification/typing or explicitly narrow the eligibility semantics before repository-CI reconciliation.
